description: This PHP source file manages the Wi-Fi settings step in a web-based router or gateway configuration wizard, including form handling, validation, and dynamic UI interactions for 2.4 GHz and 5 GHz Wi-Fi network configurations.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Submits the Wi-Fi configuration data via AJAX to a handler script to update the router settings.

methods.name: click_save
methods.description: Prepares Wi-Fi network configuration data from form inputs and calls set_config to save changes.
